items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Frank Snyder tells me about their meeting... where they'd come to Jim... And he said that's where he met Brunus long before they joined together to form the New Orleans Rhythm Kings.

ctx.x: Yeah, Schoble and Carl. Forgotten I know him pretty well. We were both pallbearers at Paul's funeral. But fundamentally, the Chicagoans, two from Lower Indiana, two from Lower Illinois, farm boys, were playing as a unit in Chicago before the other people were playing.

Frank Snyder tells me about their meeting, Brunus, over here on North Avenue in Halsted, where they'd come to Jim, finding some people that they could work with. And he said that's where he met Brunus long before they joined together to form the New Orleans Rhythm Kings.
I think Pettis told me that they played as two separate, that the two four-piece bands got together as an eight-piece band, often on Sundays.
